overview: Starting in early 2026, our partnership with WHOOP has grown from supporting a social series and a handful of paid ads into a much broader creative partnership spanning Ferrari content, video podcasts, paid social, design, animation, VFX, and more. Birdline has become a flexible extension of WHOOP’s in-house team, scaling alongside their needs and supporting everything from quick-turn content to larger, high-profile productions.

overview: Our Bird team partners with FreePower to produce high-quality video, photography, and VFX/animations every month, fueling their social media, website, and paid ad campaigns. From branded commercials to explainer videos, product demos, and custom animations, we create a diverse range of content tailored to their marketing strategy.

Outside of production, we collaborate closely with FreePower’s PR and marketing teams—developing storyboards, shot lists, creative briefs, and performance-driven concepts to ensure each deliverable is optimized for engagement and impact.
results: In 2024, FreePower teamed up with Birdline to launch its groundbreaking wireless charging technology and build brand awareness through expertly crafted, engaging content.
Over the past 12 months, Birdline’s efforts delivered 15M total views, 170K link clicks, and a reach of 23M users, while growing FreePower’s audience by 25K+ followers.
By leveraging creative production strategies, Birdline showcased FreePower’s technology without the need for in-home installations, lowering production costs and driving maximizing their content.

overview: We partnered with 686 to create a seamless content workflow, delivering a steady stream of paid ads, social content, and website videos. We worked closely with 686’s creative and marketing teams—shaping video concepts, leading strategic planning sessions, and optimizing every campaign for maximum impact. Through an ongoing feedback loop, we analyzed ad performance, refined edits, and adjusted strategies to enhance production quality and drive sales with high-performing direct response video ads across all social platforms.

overview: Our dedicated Bird team powers Gardyn’s content production, delivering high-quality video, photography, and graphics every month for their social media, website, and paid ads. We collaborate directly with Gardyn’s creative and marketing teams—developing storyboards, shot lists, creative briefs, and performance-driven strategies to ensure every campaign is optimized for engagement and ROI.
results: In 2024, Gardyn partnered with Birdline to introduce their new indoor gardening systems and strengthen brand awareness through highly engaging, premium content.

Over the past 12 months, our paid content drove a 28% YoY boost in CTR, while improving watch-through rates by 50%. With $8.23M ad spend, we scaled campaigns by 14%, maintaining cost efficiency with a 9% improvement in CAC.
Through our social assets, Gardyn achieved 45M+ organic views and a 111% follower growth rate, amplifying brand visibility and engagement.

overview: We have partnered with Literati as their dedicated content production team, supporting everything from video editing and graphic design to full-scale campaign content and animation. We work closely with their internal creative team and agency partners, develop assets tailored for paid ads, web assets, and their B2B model.

Our role has been to take Literati’s mission — inspiring a love of reading in kids — and translate it into content that not only connects emotionally with families, but also performs across channels. From polished brand videos to playful motion graphics and quick-turn ad edits, every piece of content is crafted to both tell Literati’s story and meet their marketing objectives.

What makes our collaboration effective is the way we integrate into their workflow. With Birdline’s production model, we provide an always-on creative pipeline that adapts to testing, iteration, and performance insights. Every deliverable is built to drive immediate results while fueling the next campaign, creating a compounding effect of stronger messaging and higher returns.
We operate as an extension of the Literati team — not just a vendor, but a true production partner driving performance through content.

overview: We partnered with Patrol as a full-service content team, leading creative development and production across campaigns that build awareness, trust, and adoption for the Patrol app. From premium brand commercials to authentic UGC storytelling, we’ve helped shape Patrol’s message around proactive, community-funded security — showing real families taking protection into their own hands.

What makes our partnership effective is the integration of our strategic creative approach with a nimble, always-on production workflow. We work end-to-end — from scripting through final edit — so the Patrol team can focus on growth while we handle the storytelling. Each piece of content is designed to drive performance now and feed the next campaign, creating a snowball effect of momentum and message consistency. We operate as an extension of the Patrol team — not just a vendor, but a production partner.
results: 1. Brand Commercials We launched two high-quality, narrative-driven brand spots titled “When Seconds Matter” and “Private Patrol” that positions Patrol as a game-changing tool for community safety.

2. UGC Campaigns We scripted, shot, and edited multiple user-generated-style videos. Our UGC pieces were designed to feel authentic and relatable, featuring real families, natural settings, and direct-to-camera storytelling.

3. Social Content & Paid Ads We created numerous short-form assets for Instagram and Meta, pulling from both our brand commercials and UGC campaigns. Our Private Patrol spot on X alone generated 12M views, 4K reposts, 8K likes, 3K saves, and 1.5K comments. All in one week.

overview: We provide Public Rec with a dedicated content team, ensuring a steady flow of high-quality video, photography, and edits each month. Our Birds handle recurring shoots to capture their full product line, leveraging top-tier talent and production crews to create compelling ads, social content, TV commercials, and more.

Beyond production, we collaborate directly with their creative and marketing teams—developing large-scale commercial campaigns, refining performance-driven edits, and continuously optimizing content through real-time feedback loops. This ongoing partnership fuels their direct response ad success across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube.
results: From 2021 to 2025, Public Rec invested under $1M in Birdline productions and creative partnership, turning that into over $53M in returns across TV and Meta.
For TV alone, $8M in total spend (including production) generated $32M in revenue, a 4x return, with one 30-second spot achieving a 51.7x ROAS—all from existing footage.

As a result of our strategic collaboration, 7 national TV commercials, and compounding creative production process, Public Rec attracted its first institutional investor in 2023 and was acquired by NOBULL in 2026.

overview: Birdline’s partnership with Solidroad has grown from an initial brand and product video project into an ongoing, embedded content partnership supporting nearly every part of their content engine. Together, we’ve handled on-site productions, founder and team storytelling, event coverage, customer interviews, thought leadership, paid and organic social creative, custom animation, and ongoing post-production, working closely with the Solidroad team to quickly turn ideas and moments into a consistent stream of high-quality content across channels.
results: Our partnership with Solidroad has helped turn individual productions into a scalable content engine. One two-day shoot alone generated 50+ pieces of content across customer stories, team perspectives, interviews, announcements, and social-first formats, giving the team a much deeper library of creative to use across organic, paid, events, and ongoing campaigns.
